@@U03504@@
Most honored and reverend ladies! Permit me to draw near to receive your triple blessing. I approach you, a stranger, to be sure, but unless ’m mistaken, also a distant relative. I have laid eyes on ancient gods before; just yesterday 1 bowed my deepest to 奥普斯 and 瑞亚. The three Fates, sisters of 卡俄斯, and yours as well, I saw yesterday— or was it the day before? But the likes of you I’ve never seen. So delighted am I, words fail me altogether.

@@U03506@@
He seems quite intelligent, this spirit.

@@U03508@@
What surprises me is no poet has sung your praises. Tell me, now, how is that possible? When have I ever seen statues of you, worthy ones? It’s you, ladies, you that sculptors should sculpt. Not 朱诺, 帕拉斯, 维纳斯, and the like.

@@U03510@@
Sunk in the depths of solitude and stillest night, the thought has never crossed our mind.

@@U03512@@

translation:
@@U03504@@
最尊敬和尊敬的女士们！请允许我靠近接受你的三重祝福。我走近你，当然，你是一个陌生人，但如果没有弄错的话，我也是一个远房亲戚。我以前曾见过远古诸神；就在昨天，我向奥普斯和瑞亚深深鞠了一躬。命运三女神，卡俄斯的姐妹，还有你的姐妹，我昨天看到了——还是前天？但像你这样的人我从未见过。我实在是太高兴了，简直无法用言语来形容。

@@U03506@@
看来他还挺聪明的，这精神。

@@U03508@@
令我惊讶的是没有诗人歌颂过你。现在告诉我，这怎么可能？我什么时候见过你们的雕像，值得尊敬的人？女士们，雕塑家应该雕刻的是你们。不是朱诺、帕拉斯、维纳斯之类的。

@@U03510@@
沉浸在孤独和最寂静的夜晚的深处，这个想法从未在我们的脑海中闪过。

@@U03512@@
